thread:
gabi: FYI I'm seeing a fragmentation spiral in us-central1 where fractional GPU requests + node shape heterogeneity is causing tiny pods to litter racks and block larger model jobs. logging here.
noah: that sounds new. what changed?
gabi: we recently enabled fractional-gpu across several clusters last week to increase binpacking density. combined with some new M60-like nodes in the mix (different memory shapes) the scheduler's binpack heuristic misestimates leftover capacity. result: lots of 0.25 GPU tiny-pods distributed and then larger pods can't fit and get pending for long before eviction/reschedule churn.
sre-bot: alert: pending_pods>300 in us-central1 at 12:07 UTC.
tess: any metrics on fragmentation? e.g., free-GPU-slices-per-node distribution?
gabi: yes - attached snapshot summary: 60% nodes have <0.5 free GPU but >0 free; 25% nodes have >1 free but scattered. cluster-level fragmentation index jumped from 0.18 -> 0.44 after the change.
noah: mitigation ideas: 1) reserve a small number of nodes for large-gang allocations (warm-pool), 2) prefer packing tiny pods into specific islands (binpack islands) rather than scatter across racks, 3) enforce node shape-aware packing where leftover fractional GPUs of different shapes aren't mixed.
gabi: implemented a quick soft policy: set preferential nodeSelector for tiny-worker to node-label role=frac-worker, and annotate nodes to pick them. early results: pending large-gangs dropped by 40% in 10m.
tess: that's promising. can this be automated? e.g., a placement class for fractional workloads.
gabi: I'll prototype a placementClass CRD + scheduler plugin that tags pods <=0.5 gpu with packingClass=frac and runtime will prefer frac islands.
oah: cost tradeoffs: reserving islands reduces immediate density but reduces OOM/preempt churn for big models. run sim on canary cluster first.
gabi: created issue and assigned: #445-frag-islands. also adding a periodic defragmenter job that tries to consolidate fractional pods when load low.
sre-bot: autoscaler: us-central1 pending nodes requested +15 at 12:10:05 UTC.
tess: schedule: prototype CRD in 2 wks, pilot in canary, then rollout. make sure metrics for fragmentation are added to console dashboards.
gabi: will add metric panels: fractional_slices_free_distribution and fragmentation_index. thanks all.
